evidence.note: Reads the template training script to understand model, training loop, evaluation and quantization setup before acting.

Probes the environment with measured facts: GPU (nvidia-smi), PyTorch/CUDA & flash-attention availability, data shard count/sizes, searches for the grader script to learn how val_bpb is computed, decodes val set to measure char/byte-vs-token ratio, and confirms tokenizer vocab size.

Derives parameter counts and estimated compressed checkpoint sizes across architectures, then empirically measures zlib compression ratio on simulated int8 weights to verify the 32MB budget — a first-principles bytes-per-param-under-int8+compression picture.
Only after this research enters plan mode and writes a design grounded in the measured facts.

reasoning: The agent's opening arc is almost entirely well-targeted orientation: it reads the template, probes GPU/framework/data/tokenizer for measured facts, investigates how bpb is computed, and derives a quantitative param/size/compression budget that it validates empirically (steps 10-11) — matching the level-8 anchor and touching level-10's first-principles size derivation. It falls short of a full 10 because there is no visible tiny probe independently verifying the exact dual load path and forward(input_ids,target_ids)==cross_entropy / int8 round-trip contract before committing compute; that contract was only read in the template, leaving a potential silent-failure mode unexamined.
